free_parameters.name: block_size
free_parameters.why: prompt fits in one logical block; the decode loop only needs the block table length to match, so block size does not affect can_append_slot

free_parameters.name: prompt_len
free_parameters.why: one short sequence whose prompt is already processed; prompt length is irrelevant once prompt_processing_finished is True

free_parameters.name: max_model_len
free_parameters.why: only stored by the block manager; it does not enter can_append_slot, which reads the free-block count

free_parameters.name: chunk_size
free_parameters.why: the decode loop needs num_batched_tokens < chunk_size; one decode step is far below any positive chunk size

free_parameters.name: max_tokens
free_parameters.why: sampling limit for the generated token; not consulted by the scheduling decision

free_parameters.name: eos_token_id
free_parameters.why: the sequence has no output tokens yet, so end-of-sequence is never checked in the decode pass

free_parameters.name: execution_threshold
free_parameters.why: deadline slack constant used after the target line; it only lands in a float local, not in the branch condition

free_parameters.name: execution_threshold_batched
free_parameters.why: the batched deadline constant used by _get_TBT_deadline below the target; same reason

free_parameters.name: scheduler_type
free_parameters.why: the target decode pass does not branch on scheduler_type; only the later prefill sizing does

free_parameters.name: hybrid_prioritization_param
free_parameters.why: default value copied from DeadlineScheduler.__init__; not read before the target

free_parameters.name: output_len_pred
free_parameters.why: default used only for tier-based deadline adjustment of waiting sequences; there are none

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: Sequence assigns a random tier on construction; fixing the seed makes the run reproducible, the tier does not influence can_append_slot
